title: ModelRequirement
description: User-facing requirement for selecting model endpoints from the catalog. Used by the web UI to filter / rank endpoints against what the user actually needs.

useCases.description: Use-case tags the user wants to satisfy. Free-form strings; matched against endpoint capabilities.

capabilities.description: Required capability flags. An endpoint matches a flag when the flag is set on its `capabilities` dict (or derived from architecture / use_case labels for AMD/NVIDIA/HF respectively).

vision.description: Endpoint must accept image inputs (HF: `input_modalities` contains `image`; NVIDIA: `architecture.input` contains `image`; AMD: derived from `provider_pricing[0].vision`).

toolCalling.description: Endpoint must support tool/function calling (NVIDIA: `capabilities.tool_calling`; HF: `metadata.supports_tools`; AMD: derived from `provider_pricing[0].tools`).

structuredOutput.description: Endpoint must support structured output (HF: `metadata.supports_structured_output`; AMD: derived; NVIDIA: derived).

reasoning.description: Endpoint advertises a reasoning/CoT capability. No provider exposes this directly today; the field is reserved for future provider metadata.

contextWindow.description: Minimum acceptable context window length (in tokens). An endpoint matches when its `context_length` is >= `min` (or unknown / null).

min.description: Lower bound on context window size. Endpoints without a known context length are treated as matches.

pricing.description: Pricing constraints. All sub-fields are AND-combined: an endpoint matches when every constraint here passes.

input.description: Maximum acceptable input price (USD per token, raw float). Endpoints without an `input` price field are treated as matches.

output.description: Maximum acceptable output price (USD per token, raw float).

free.description: If true, only `ModelEndpoint.free == true` endpoints match. If false, only paid endpoints match (`free == false`). If omitted, no constraint is applied (any free flag is accepted).

providers.description: Whitelist of provider names. If non-empty, an endpoint matches only when its `provider` is in the list. If empty / omitted, all providers match.

endpointCount.description: Reserved for future use. Intended to express 'I need N endpoints that satisfy the rest of this requirement'. The current web UI does not enforce this field.

constraints.description: Non-functional constraints. All providers currently leave these unset; the field is reserved for future provider metadata.

latency.description: Maximum acceptable first-token latency in milliseconds.

throughput.description: Minimum acceptable throughput in tokens per second.
